senses.gloss: SV0089 दिनचर्या dinacaryā Made out of two words, Dina and Charya. Dina refers to Day/day time/day today and Charya refers to regimen/routine work which includes Ahara (Food) and Vihara (activities), thus Dinacharaya means daily routines or day to day regimens.
AF0699 दीन मुखं dīna mukhaṁ Exhausted face
